account.title: Bambu Lab account
account.description:
Filament Stock reads your spools from the Bambu Lab cloud: the filament list you manage in Bambu Studio or the Bambu Handy app. The cloud is required, the integration does not work without it.

Your password is only used to get a sign-in token and is never stored. The token lasts about 90 days, Home Assistant asks you to sign in again before it expires.

The Bambu Lab cloud API is unofficial and may change without notice.

drive.title: Google Drive print queue
drive.description:
Filament Stock reads your sliced plates (`*.gcode.3mf`) from a Google Drive folder, read-only. You need two things: a **JSON key** of a Google service account and the **folder ID**.

**JSON key**
1. [Create a Google Cloud project]({project_url}) (or pick an existing one).
2. [Enable the Google Drive API]({api_url}) for that project.
3. Open [Service accounts]({accounts_url}) and click **Create service account**. A name is enough, skip the roles.
4. Open the new account, tab **Keys**, then **Add key > Create new key > JSON**. Your browser downloads a `.json` file.
5. Open that file in a text editor (Notepad, TextEdit), select all and paste it below. Never paste it in a chat or issue.

**Folder ID**
6. Copy the service account email from the JSON file (`client_email`, ends with `iam.gserviceaccount.com`).
7. In [Google Drive]({drive_url}) on the web, right-click the folder with your plates, choose **Share** and add that email as **Viewer**.
8. Open the folder. The address bar shows `drive.google.com/drive/folders/<ID>`. Paste the whole address or only the ID below.

Full guide and troubleshooting: {setup_url}

data_description.service_account: The full contents of the downloaded `.json` key file, including the first and last curly bracket. When reconfiguring, leave empty to keep the stored key.
data_description.folder_id: The address of the Drive folder from your browser, or only the part after `/folders/`.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description:
Choose how Filament Stock tells you about new spools, low or negative balances, unsliced files and an expiring Bambu Lab sign-in.

**Recommended: WhatsApp Notifier** ({whatsapp_url}). Free, sends WhatsApp messages straight from Home Assistant, no external server or paid API. Be aware that it relies on an unofficial WhatsApp protocol. Install it first, then pick it here.

Any other `notify` entity works too. If sending fails, a persistent notification in Home Assistant is used.
